items.title: PCRS and NHS Wales primary care respiratory update, Cardiff, 20 October 2026
items.summary: PCRS is running a one-day essential primary care respiratory update in Cardiff on Tuesday 20 October 2026, with NHS Wales Performance and Improvement and members of the National Respiratory Audit Programme. A concentrated Welsh primary care respiratory audience.

items.title: PCRS webinar on breathlessness and chronic cough in adults, 30 September
items.summary: PCRS emailed members on 14 August 2026 announcing a webinar, Breathlessness and chronic cough in adults: challenges currently being faced by primary care, on Wednesday 30 September 2026, 19:00 to 20:00. Date and time taken from the PCRS mailing; not yet confirmed on the public PCRS events listing.

items.title: NHS England instructs GP practices to dismiss staff caught ‘snooping’ on patient records
items.summary: GP practices should sack employees caught ‘snooping’ patient records ‘in almost all cases’, according to NHS England.

items.title: Implementing Benedict’s law: guidance from a school nurse
items.summary: Following the launch of new statutory allergy safety guidance this month, all state-maintained schools, academies and free schools are expected to meet a number of requirements relating to staff allergy training and allergy safety policies, among other things.

items.title: A quicker way to work through patient symptoms
items.summary: Tiredness. Calf pain. A persistent cough. An unfamiliar rash. In primary care, a seemingly straightforward symptom can have a long list of possible causes. Nursing in Practice Reference is designed to help nurses work through them.

items.title: Semaglutide linked to 40% reduction in asthma attacks
items.summary: Weight loss and diabetes treatment semaglutide is associated with a nearly 40% reduction in asthma attacks among people with the condition, according to new analysis.
